# Camp Pets: Bombay Black Cat

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Oct 26, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Dec 11, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_7cadc483920e48009c6685a88b93cc0d~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Being superstitious does not detract from how cute this Bombay Cat truly is!

Camp Pets cannot be built inside of a Shelter.

- C.A.M.P. PETS APPEAR ONCE THEIR FURNITURE IS PLACED IN C.A.M.P. MODE. -

__Bombay Cat__

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_12e8b2ce04d1443a9e740d6dc4b577fc~mv2.jpg)

**Type**

Cat

**Stats**

- Immune to Cannibal effects
- Immune to Nukes
- Immune to Scorched Conversion
- Immune to Radiation
- Immune to Death
- Immune to Bleeding

**Camp Item**

Bombay Cat Bed

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_67edc203bda143e0942cbe927aa79a0e~mv2.jpg)

**Build limit per camp**

1 per camp

**Build limit per workshop**

0 per workshop

**Shares a build limit with**

Camp Pets

(Does not count towards Camp Allies)

**Found Under in Camp Build Menu**

Dwellers

**Obtainable via**

Season 19 Season Pass - Gleaming Depths - 50 tickets

Gold Bullion - X - X - X Bullion

**Daily Quest**

No

**Buffs/Services**

No

**Gifts**

Your pet will gift you a Legendary Weapon every 2 hours.

- 100% chance for a 1-star Legendary Ranged or Melee Weapon
- 20% chance for a 2-star Legendary Ranged or Melee Weapon
- 10% chance for a 3-star Legendary Ranged or Melee Weapon

The gift timer counts down from 2 hours. Your pet will give you the item when it reaches 0 and you’re in your CAMP. If the timer hits 0 but you’re not in your CAMP, the countdown pauses until you return. This means if you’re away for 3 hours after the timer hits 0, it won’t start the next countdown until you get back.

Note: Gifts don’t stack. Waiting 4 hours won’t get you two gifts; you’ll only receive one gift when you return.

When the game decides which weapon you’ll receive, it checks for the highest possible rank first:

- Rank 3 (3-star weapon) – 10% chance.
- Rank 2 (2-star weapon) – 20% chance if Rank 3 is not awarded.
- Rank 1 (1-star weapon) – 100% chance if neither Rank 3 nor Rank 2 is awarded.
